responsibility: Declares GCC’s generic debug-output hook interface used by the front end, middle end, and final emission code to communicate with format-specific debug writers. The header defines struct gcc_debug_hooks and its callbacks for compilation-unit setup, source locations, blocks, functions, globals, types, imported declarations, labels, variable locations, inline events, and section switches; it also declares the standard hook tables such as DWARF and do-nothing hooks, helper stub functions, selected DWARF frame-related entry points, and the decl-to-instance mapping support shared with final debug emission.
same_name_distinction: Defines the abstract debug hook interface and exports hook tables such as do_nothing_debug_hooks and dwarf2_debug_hooks, whereas debug.cc only supplies one concrete do-nothing implementation of that interface.
